card.name: Digits inside numbers in dosing text
card.fires_on: A digit or decimal point partway through a number, often the second digit or the point, in dose ranges, lab thresholds and counts. It appears just before a unit such as mg, mL or a percent.

modes.label: Second digit of a number
modes.description: The last digit of a two-digit or longer dose or lab value, just before the unit.
modes.example: the recommended initial daily oral dose in infants is 2.5 to 1<<0>> mL in divided doses

modes.label: Decimal point in a value
modes.description: The point inside a decimal lab value or reference number.
modes.example: Serum calcium should be below 9<<.>>8 mg/dL before initiating treatment.

card.plain: It fires on the middle of a number in a dose or lab value, before the unit comes.
